full_judgment: 3. The respondent No. 1 filed the above Criminal Misc. (Contempt) Case No. 386 of 1997 against the appellants and proforma respondent No.2 before the High Court Division stating inter alia that she, having obtained a decree in Title Suit No. 808 of 1985 from the Court of 2nd Sub-Ordinate Judge,(Now Joint District/ Judge) Dhaka, declaring her title and for recovery of khas possession of the properties as described in the schedule of the plaint, filed Execution Case No.28 of 1986 in the above Court and on her prayer for police help in getting delivery of possession, the above execution Court after having received confirmation from the appellant No.1 by Memo dated 15.4.97 regarding deployment of force, issued writ fixing 22.4.1997 for execution of the same but on 22.4.1997 at 10-00 a.m. when the process server of the executing Court went to the appellant No.2 and requested him to deploy police force for the execution of the writ, the appellant No.2, without supplying police force to him, handed over to him a photocopy of the memo No. Sec.10/A-P-114/84290 dated 21.4.1.997 issued by proforma respondent No.2 addressed to the appellant No.1 and also the Memo dated 22.4.97 issued by the appellant No.1 forwarding the copies of the Memo dated 21.4.97 to the appellant No.2, the Deputy Commissioner (Riot) North D.M.M. Dhaka, the Assistant Commissioner Mirpur Zone, Riot, North D.M.P. Dhaka and also to the executing Court; the above Memo dated 21.4.97 contained the statement to the effect that an appeal against the judgment and decree, out of which the execution case arose, is pending before the court of District Judge, Dhaka; the process server then on the same day at about 2 P.M. submitted report to the executing Court disclosing the above facts; the appellant No. 1 on 22.4.97 also sent a copy of the above memo dated 21.4.97 to the executing Court, then the executing Court on 24.4.97 referring to the Memo dated 22.4.97 issued by the appellant No.1 passed an order staying further proceeding of the above execution case and also recalled the process relating thereto the proforma respondent No.2 by issuing the aforesaid memo dated 21.4.97 to appellant No.1 and the appellant No.1 by forwarding copy thereof to the executing Court by Memo dated 22.4.97 and appellant No.2 by refusing to deploy police force to the process server committed offence amounting to contempt of court.
